what: Lighthouse 13.5 lab numbers for the four T0 trains before and after the perf work (R0 banner CLS fix; PERF group for R1a+), plus the applied-throttling probe and the findings behind the gates proposed in docs/plan/FINAL/02-tranche0-hotfix-runbook.md section 14.18-14.20

method.lighthouse: 13.5.0 attached to the harness Chrome (tests/t0/lib.mjs openSession) over its debugging port; categories performance+accessibility; simulated (Lantern) throttling, mobile preset 412x823 @1.75 4x CPU 1.6 Mbps 150 ms, desktop preset; Mapbox tile requests carry the production Referer through the harness (tiles per run 13-72, cap 300 per process); telemetry stubbed
method.runs: fresh Chrome profile and server per run, one run at a time (lock), interleaved before/after per round; mobile n=15 per tree (rounds 61-65 and 71-80), desktop n=5, legacy baseline n=10 mobile / 5 desktop; process priority above normal
method.trees: before = release/<train>/dist as built from HEAD 5de02c8 (R0 fb14ab00, R1a 740deb52, R1b 8ad6d7cd, R1c 9feb2ee6); after = the same plus the R0M banner row and, for R1a+, PERF.json (isolated working copy; the release ids do not change: no bundle byte changed)
method.host: Windows 11, 16 cores, shared with other agents (cpu busy 30-50 % during runs, benchmarkIndex 3400-4300, median about 3800; the verifier's host was about 4200): absolute scores are 2-3 points lower than on a quiet host
method.probe: boot-probe: Chrome with CDP Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate 4 and Network.emulateNetworkConditions 1.6 Mbps/150 ms APPLIED, 412x823 touch viewport, real tiles, 14 s; FCP/LCP/CLS from PerformanceObserver, TBT = longtask API after FCP; app-mount time is unreliable in this probe (the network condition is sometimes not applied to the entry download: bimodal 1.4/4.6 s) and is not reported

cls.after_runs_nonzero: 0 of 21 on each of R0, R1a, R1b, R1c
cls.culprit: div#root > div > div > div (the Choose Your Experience column), +89 px when the banner is inserted after the first paint

render_blocking_insight.after: passes on 63 of 63 runs (R1a..R1c); R0 unchanged by design

tbt_anatomy_R0_mobile_real_tiles.lantern_replay: R0 run: tasks counted = module compile+evaluate 48 ms (simulated 191, counted 141), React commit + Map constructor 111 ms (222, 172, layout-containing task scaled x2), first Mapbox render 114 ms (457, 407); TBT 724 before windowing (680 reported)
tbt_anatomy_R0_mobile_real_tiles.cpu_profile_1x: first React commit layout 53 ms (LoAF render time; 271 layout objects), Map constructor 86 ms of which Context constructor self 66 ms and _setupPainter 10 ms, first full render 108 ms of which Program._finalize self 94 ms (blocking getProgramParameter(LINK_STATUS) for the symbol shaders); thread CPU time (trace tdur) of the 111 ms and 114 ms tasks is only 29 ms and 18 ms: the main thread waits on the software-GL process
tbt_anatomy_R0_mobile_real_tiles.R1c_profile_1x: Program._finalize self 127 ms in total, 93 ms of it in one 120 ms span
tbt_anatomy_R0_mobile_real_tiles.inline_scripts_after_fcp: index.html inline scripts total about 4-9 ms CPU after first paint (populate, mover, pollers): not a TBT lever
tbt_anatomy_R0_mobile_real_tiles.tiles_blocked: verifier 2: R0 TBT 135 ms and score 99 with tiles blocked; real tiles add about 500 ms TBT and about 15 points

rejected_experiments.prefetch_entry: R0 + <link rel=prefetch as=script>: second download of the entry, mount 4.6 -> 7.1 s at 4x CPU / slow 4G (3 of 3 runs)
rejected_experiments.modulepreload_low: R0 + modulepreload fetchpriority=low: mount 4.1-4.5 vs 4.56-4.58 s, FCP unchanged; forbidden by gate r0-mechanism and prod-probe T0-05
rejected_experiments.inline_css: R0 with both stylesheets inlined: FCP 837 vs 945 ms, +9 KB brotli per no-cache HTML, score 79 (78-81) vs 81-82 for the interleaved control (n=5)
rejected_experiments.map_constructor_task: R0 with new Map() moved into a setTimeout(0) task: score 79 (78-81) vs 81-82 for the interleaved control (n=5), no TBT gain; collides with A2-map-attribution-and-setup
rejected_experiments.css_defer_without_critical_css: R1b/R1c: CLS 0.040 (skip links and sr-only h1 visible at first paint) - cured by PERF-critical-css-inline
rejected_experiments.duplicate_fetches: 0 duplicate requests reach the server on a first visit (server ledger, R0 and R1c phone): the second fetch of commander_successions.json, chronology_day1-3.json and icons/icon-192.png is a Chrome cache hit (Lighthouse transferSize 0)

gates_proposed.rule: median of 5, quiet host (benchmarkIndex >= 3800, nothing else running), real tiles
gates_proposed.tbt_under_200: not reachable in T0 (needs the rebuild: lazy map chunk, yielding between evaluation, mount, constructor and layers)
